objective: Deliver the QSystem shell through the approved constitution, specification, plan, implementation, and task-tracking workflow.

tasks.title: Task 1: monorepo and infrastructure
tasks.body: Status: completed. Verify or preserve the pnpm workspace and four-service development infrastructure. Evidence: commit c409e80 and SDD Task 1 report.

tasks.title: Task 2: schema and RLS
tasks.body: Status: completed. Preserve restricted qsystem_app access, RLS policies, scoped Prisma access, and negative tests. Evidence: commits ee6d164, c3c14da, 8db2414; 7/7 RLS tests.

tasks.title: Task 3: JWT IAM and refresh rotation
tasks.body: Status: completed. Preserve JWT IAM, refresh rotation/reuse detection, rate limits, logout, password change, and /me. Evidence: commits 8ce9586 and 16d9ee0; IAM tests pass.

tasks.title: Task 4: OrgModule and CASL sensors
tasks.body: Status: completed. Preserve organization scope, 4W guard, flow-2 monitor-only rule, audit stub, and field filtering. Evidence: commits a86742f and 40a765c; sensors tests pass.

tasks.title: Task 5: shared contracts
tasks.body: Status: completed for backend contracts. Preserve Zod auth/org/notify/search contracts and API DTO parity. Evidence: commit 0d1e5b5; 7 contract tests pass.

tasks.title: Task 6: notification outbox and workers
tasks.body: Status: pending. Implement outbox transaction, BullMQ notify/scheduled workers, retry 3, dead-letter handling, provider adapters, and offline notification sync. Use NotifyPayload from contracts.

tasks.title: Task 7: scoped search and storage
tasks.body: Status: pending. Implement Meilisearch scope filtering, MinIO-compatible presigned storage, and scope checks on reads.

tasks.title: Task 8: web shell and App Switcher
tasks.body: Status: deferred by approved R7 scope. Implement only after explicit frontend approval, using the contracts and registry produced by the backend sequence.

tasks.title: Task 9: audit errors and CI
tasks.body: Status: pending. Add standard exception shape, audit interceptor coverage, and CI lint/test/build gates.
